messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: EdgeWare SI go-live stalled at step 4. Marketplace image failed signature verification for their private registry. Field eng paused. Need a fast unblock.

Nora: Checking logs 0: signature check 401 for image redwood-edge-1.2. Partner cert not bundled into the airgap installer.

Lee: We can push a signed hotfix image and a checksum. Build+sign takes ~90m. Do we want to do a temporary allowlist bypass? Not ideal.

Ravi: Partner prefers no bypass. Lee, build hotfix and provide SHA. Nora, prepare clear install steps for field eng with checksum and cert path.

Lee: Starting build. ETA 1.5h. I'll upload to S3 and share URL+sha256.

deploy-bot: build-job #build-5903 started; logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/5903

Nora: Drafting install snippet: \n```\ncurl -O https://s3.redwood/hotfixes/edgeware-1.2-hotfix.tar.gz
sha256sum edgeware-1.2-hotfix.tar.gz # verify sha: 3f2a...
sudo ./install.sh --extra-cert /tmp/edgeware-cert.pem
```\n
Ravi: Also need alert routing: partner-eng must get critical deploy pages for first 48h. PD-ops can we do a manual forward?

PD-ops: We can enable a temporary forward for 24-48h. Please provide the list of alert keys to forward. We recommend forwarding only severity=critical + tag=deployment.

Lee: Hotfix uploaded, URL + sha in the build logs. Pushed artifact and cert to ticket.

Ravi: Partner accepted the hotfix and completed install. Field eng reports success. Nora: please open runbook PR to add cert-to-bundle checklist + PD manual-forward steps.

Nora: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/534 (includes installer checklist and PD filter snippet).

Ravi: Great work. We'll schedule a 72h check-in and add CI canary to verify partner certs in future builds. :thumbsup:
